:= by
  have := Multiset.Icc_eq_Ico (a ≤ b) (Icc_le_Ico a b)
  rw [Multiset.Icc, Multiset.Icc]
  induction' (Ico a b) with x xs
  case empty =>
    show Multiset.map (fun x => c + x) ∅ = Multiset.Icc (c + a) (c + b)
    simp [Multiset.map, Multiset.Icc]
  case cons x xs =>
    have : Ico a b = {x} ++ Ico (x + 1) b := by rw [Ico.add_singleton]
    rw [this]
    simp [Multiset.map]
    have : Multiset.Icc (c + a) (c + b) = {c + a} ++ Multiset.Icc (c + a) (c + b) \ {c + a} :=
      by rw [Multiset.Icc]
    rw [this]
    have : Multiset.Icc (c + a) (c + b) \ {c + a} = Multiset.Icc (c + (a + 1)) (c + b) :=
      by rw [Icc.remove_singleton]
    rw [this]
    have : Multiset.map (fun x => c + x) xs = Multiset.Icc (c + (a + 1)) (c + b) :=
      by rw [Ico.add_singleton, Multiset.map]
    rw [this]
    have : {c + a} ++ Multiset.Icc (c + (a + 1)) (c + b) = Multiset.Icc (c + a) (c + b) :=
      by rw [Icc.add_singleton]
    rw [this]
